# DevExpress.Win.Navigation NuGet Package

This package contains DevExpress WinForms controls that help you create navigation interfaces inspired by Windows and Office applications, from simple sidebars to advanced multilevel navigation containers. Visit DevExpress.com for additional information: [DevExpress WinForms Navigation Controls](https://www.devexpress.com/products/net/controls/winforms/navigation/).

## Key Components

* [DevExpress WinForms Ribbon Control](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/2500/controls-and-libraries/ribbon-bars-and-menu/ribbon)

* [DevExpress WinForms Bar Manager](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/5361/controls-and-libraries/ribbon-bars-and-menu/bars)

* [DevExpress WinForms Accordion Control](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/114553/controls-and-libraries/navigation-controls/accordion-control)

* [DevExpress WinForms DockManager](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/5368/controls-and-libraries/docking-library) & [DocumentManager](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/11359/controls-and-libraries/application-ui-manager)

* [DevExpress WinForms LayoutControl](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/17579/controls-and-libraries/form-layout-managers/layout-and-data-layout-controls/layout-control)

* [DevExpress WinForms Navigation Frame](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/114554/controls-and-libraries/navigation-controls/navigation-frame-and-tab-pane)

* [DevExpress WinForms Editors](https://docs.devexpress.com/WindowsForms/116782/controls-and-libraries/ribbon-bars-and-menu/bars/tutorials/add-bar-items-to-toolbars)

## Evaluation Period, Pricing Options, and Licensing Terms

Whether you own a license or want to start a 30-day evaluation, download and register your DevExpress license key. To obtain the key, sign in to the [DevExpress Download Manager](https://www.devexpress.com/ClientCenter/DownloadManager/) with your existing DevExpress.com account or create a free account. For instructions on key registration, see [License Key for DevExpress Products](https://www.devexpress.com/go/Licensing_Documentation.aspx).

If you purchase a license after evaluating a product, you need to re-register your updated DevExpress license key to remove evaluation warnings and messages.
